own_original_works.rule: Rawafid may identify itself as publisher only for works it actually publishes and for which it has the necessary rights.

licensed_translations.rule: A translation may enter the publishing workflow only when the underlying licence permits adaptation/translation or written permission has been verified.

third_party_discovery.rule: Third-party works remain attributed to their original publishers; open metadata does not transfer publishing rights.

authorized_co_management.rule: Requires explicit authorization from the original publisher and any platform-side approval required by Thoth.

thoth.safety_rule: No real test record is created in Thoth. No record is uploaded until local rights, editorial, accessibility, metadata and file gates are complete and the current Thoth template/schema mapping is verified.

notes: Scientific review is required only when the work type and claims require it; literary works use an appropriate editorial review model.
No private contracts, email bodies, invitation links, authentication tokens, unpublished manuscripts or sensitive internal notes are stored in public metadata.
The Thoth publisher display name remains unverified locally until it is confirmed inside the activated account; the requested onboarding value is recorded separately to avoid guessing.
